verdict.rationale: Hardware security keys and passkeys as a second factor are a fair question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions WebAuthn, U2F, passkeys, or any two-factor authentication. The only security-related evidence covers adjacent controls (permissions, ACLs, audit logs, SAML SSO, OAuth2/OIDC), which earn no credit for this story.
